about: Every source GovGraph uses: organizations (who publishes), their history (lineage), and datasets (what they publish, under what terms, how we get it). Entered by hand; loaded by server/seed/load-sources.js; checked by server/lib/sources.test.js. Files are not listed here: they are found in the data folder and matched to a dataset by `paths` (prefixes of their path in the data folder). Federal works are public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105; any other licence was read on the publisher's site on the date in `checked`.

datasets.name: Statistical Abstract of the United States
datasets.description: The yearly compendium of U.S. statistics, published from 1878; every table names its source. GovGraph's list of what to collect and the order its data is arranged in. The 2012 edition (131st) is the last.

licence.note: Tables from private sources may be copyrighted by those sources; the Abstract says so.

datasets.name: ProQuest Statistical Abstract of the United States
datasets.description: ProQuest's continuation of the Statistical Abstract after the Census Bureau ended it, from the 2013 edition.
datasets.outside_abstract: A private continuation of the Abstract, listed for completeness; not collected.

datasets.name: Current Population Survey: Labor Force Statistics
datasets.description: The monthly household survey behind the unemployment rate: employment, unemployment and the labor force, by sex, race, age, education and more, from 1940. BLS survey code `ln`.

access.note: download.bls.gov refuses requests without a contact address in the User-Agent (BLS_CONTACT_EMAIL). Three headline series still come from the API (no key needed; BLS_API_KEY raises the limits).

datasets.name: Consumer Price Index
datasets.description: Prices paid by urban consumers, all items from 1913. BLS survey code `cu`.

access.note: download.bls.gov refuses requests without a contact address in the User-Agent (BLS_CONTACT_EMAIL).

datasets.name: National Income and Product Accounts
datasets.description: GDP and its parts, personal income and spending, PCE prices, government receipts and expenditures, trade: every NIPA series in flat files by frequency.

datasets.name: Petroleum and Other Liquids
datasets.description: Crude oil spot prices, retail gasoline and diesel prices, and product supplied (U.S. oil demand).

access.note: EIA publishes the same series as bulk zips (PET.zip) that need no key.

datasets.name: Debt to the Penny
datasets.description: Total public debt outstanding and debt held by the public, each business day from April 1993.

datasets.name: Monthly Treasury Statement
datasets.description: Each month's federal receipts, outlays and deficit, receipts by source and refunds, from FY 2015 in Fiscal Data.

datasets.name: Daily Treasury Statement
datasets.description: Treasury's cash each business day: tax deposits and refund withdrawals, from October 2005.

datasets.name: Historical Tables, Budget of the U.S. Government
datasets.description: Receipts, outlays, deficits and debt by fiscal year from 1934 (some from 1789), published with each President's Budget.

datasets.name: The Distribution of Household Income
datasets.description: Average federal tax rates and shares of federal taxes by income group, 1979–2022 (supplemental data).

access.note: cbo.gov refuses scripted requests, so the file is taken from the Internet Archive's capture of it.

datasets.name: SOI Historical Tables
datasets.description: Statistics of Income historical tables: Table 23, individual income tax brackets 1913–2018; Table 24, corporate brackets.

datasets.name: U.S. Imports for Consumption, Duties Collected, and Ratio of Duties to Value
datasets.description: Customs duties and the value of imports each year from 1891, a PDF table.

access.note: usitc.gov refuses scripted requests, so the file is taken from the Internet Archive's capture of it.

datasets.name: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services (FT-900)
datasets.description: Exports, imports and the trade balance on a balance of payments basis: yearly from 1960, monthly from 1992 (historical series).

datasets.name: Historical Income Tables
datasets.description: Household income from the Current Population Survey's Annual Social and Economic Supplement (Table H-5 and others), and state income from the decennial censuses.

datasets.name: Housing Vacancies and Homeownership (CPS/HVS)
datasets.description: Homeownership and vacancy rates, quarterly from 1964 (historical tables).

datasets.name: New Residential Sales
datasets.description: New single-family homes sold and for sale, their prices and months' supply, monthly from 1963. Published jointly with the Department of Housing and Urban Development.

access.note: The same history is published as spreadsheets on census.gov.

datasets.name: Primary Mortgage Market Survey
datasets.description: Average 30-year and 15-year fixed mortgage rates, weekly from April 1971.

licence.attribution: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey
licence.limits: The PMMS page says its information "may be used with proper attribution" and may not be altered. The site's Terms of Use say data may not be redistributed or published without a written agreement, and forbid automated collection. The two conflict; the page's statement is the narrower one.

datasets.name: House Price Index
datasets.description: Repeat-sales indexes of single-family home prices for the nation, divisions, states and metro areas, monthly from 1991. Begun by OFHEO.

datasets.name: H.15 Selected Interest Rates
datasets.description: The federal funds rate, Treasury yields, the prime rate and other rates, daily from 1954: the whole release from the Data Download Program.

licence.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
licence.note: The Board says information on its site is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission, and asks that the Board be cited.

datasets.name: Open Market Operations: Federal Funds Target Rate
datasets.description: Every change in the FOMC's target federal funds rate or range since 1990, from the Board's Open Market Operations pages.

licence.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

datasets.name: Home Ownership Affordability Monitor
datasets.description: The share of median income needed to own a median-priced home, and an affordability index, monthly from 2005.

licence.limits: Content may be reproduced without limit if not for private gain and with attribution to the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta; reproductions that abstract its material should be sent to its Public Affairs Department.

datasets.name: Surveys of Consumers: Index of Consumer Sentiment
datasets.description: The University of Michigan's monthly index of consumer sentiment, from 1952.

licence.attribution: University of Michigan, Survey Research Center, Surveys of Consumers
licence.limits: The usage agreement forbids reproducing, retransmitting, distributing, selling, publishing or broadcasting the data without the University's written consent, and limits display to the user's own organization.

datasets.name: Provisional COVID-19 Death Counts by Week and State
datasets.description: Deaths involving COVID-19, pneumonia and influenza by week and state, from 2020 (data.cdc.gov r8kw-7aab).
datasets.outside_abstract: Covers 2020 on; the 2012 edition predates it.

datasets.name: Population Estimates
datasets.description: The Census Bureau's yearly estimates of the population of the nation and states, by age, sex, race and Hispanic origin where published, and the components of change, from 1900.

datasets.name: Decennial Census
datasets.description: The count every ten years: population of the states at every census from 1790, and apportionment of the House from 1910.

datasets.name: Historical Census Statistics on Population Totals by Race, 1790 to 1990 (Working Paper 56)
datasets.description: Census counts by race, and by Hispanic origin from 1970, for the nation, regions, divisions and states (Gibson and Jung, 2002).

datasets.name: American Community Survey, 1-Year Estimates
datasets.description: Yearly estimates for the nation, states and congressional districts from 2005 (none for 2020): the summary file tables GovGraph reads.

datasets.name: Federal Register: Presidential Documents
datasets.description: Executive orders and presidential memoranda: lists, metadata, structured HTML and PDF links, from the Federal Register API.

access.note: govinfo publishes the daily Federal Register as bulk XML (not yet used).

datasets.name: Compilation of Presidential Documents
datasets.description: The text of presidential documents (govinfo collection CPD); the plain text of Obama's executive orders comes from here.

datasets.name: Bill Status (BILLSTATUS)
datasets.description: One XML file per bill: titles, sponsors and cosponsors, actions, committees, related bills, text versions. Bulk data from the 108th Congress.

datasets.name: Congressional Bills (BILLS)
datasets.description: Every printed version of every bill, in bill XML.

datasets.name: Public and Private Laws (PLAW)
datasets.description: Slip laws as GPO publishes them; GovGraph reads each law's Statutes at Large citation from its text.

datasets.name: Congress.gov API
datasets.description: Bills, laws and actions; used for the list of enacted laws, single bills and the newest updates.

access.note: Most of the same data is in govinfo's BILLSTATUS bulk files, already used for whole Congresses.

datasets.name: House Roll Call Votes
datasets.description: Every recorded vote in the House, one XML file per roll call.
datasets.outside_abstract: Votes, not statistics. The Abstract's Elections section counts votes cast in elections, not in Congress.

datasets.name: Senate Roll Call Votes
datasets.description: Every recorded vote in the Senate, one XML file per roll call.
datasets.outside_abstract: Votes, not statistics. The Abstract's Elections section counts votes cast in elections, not in Congress.

datasets.name: congress-legislators
datasets.description: Every member of Congress since 1789, presidents and vice presidents, with their terms and their ids in other systems.

datasets.name: Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges
datasets.description: Every federal judge since 1789 with their appointments; GovGraph reads the Justices from it.

datasets.name: Supreme Court Slip Opinions
datasets.description: Each term's list of decisions and the slip opinion PDFs.

datasets.name: CourtListener
datasets.description: Court opinions and dockets; used to find each Supreme Court slip opinion's PDF and to redirect old CourtListener ids.

licence.name: Public Domain Mark 1.0
licence.note: Free Law Project marks its bulk data files "free of known copyright restrictions" (Public Domain Mark). The website itself is CC BY-ND 4.0.

access.note: Bulk exports are published quarterly; the API may stay for finding new slip opinions between them.

datasets.name: The Supreme Court Database
datasets.description: Every Supreme Court decision coded by issue, parties, disposition and votes: the Modern Database (1946 on) and the Legacy Database (1791–1945).

licence.note: Described elsewhere as Creative Commons licensed; no licence found on the current site (2026-10-13).

datasets.notes: Moved from scdb.wustl.edu (Washington University), which refused connections on 2026-10-13, to scdb.la.psu.edu (Penn State). seed/scdb.js still names the old address.

datasets.name: United States Code (release points)
datasets.description: The whole Code in USLM XML after each batch of laws.

access.note: Release 119-36 was taken from the Internet Archive while uscode.house.gov was down.

datasets.name: The 9/11 Commission Report
datasets.description: The final report (2004): the Commission's own HTML for the text, GPO's PDFs and record.

datasets.name: CAP Master Topics Codebook
datasets.description: The Comparative Agendas Project's topic system: 21 major topics and their subtopics, each with a code and a description. One of the structures on GovGraph's Structure page (server/seed/data/structures/comparative-agendas.json).

licence.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
licence.attribution: Jones, Bryan D., Frank R. Baumgartner, Sean M. Theriault, Derek A. Epp, Shruti Khandekar, Daniel Little. 2025. Policy Agendas Project: Codebook.
licence.note: Datasets and codebooks are © Comparative Agendas Project 2015; the topic codes and other project variables are under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0. Re-use must cite the How to Cite page (comparativeagendas.net/pages/How-to-cite), may not be commercial, and must be shared under the same licence: the structure file derived from it carries it. Where a dataset's codebook says so, the copyright of the primary source material applies too.

datasets.outside_abstract: A classification of policy topics, not statistics; kept as an alternative to the Abstract's own arrangement.
